pr_title: Decimal/Time implicit casting + Multi-Error store in Flush
pr_body:
This PR adds:
`TIME`
`DECIMAL`

To types that are directly cast in both the sniffer and the scanner. This means that we don't have to go through `Value` or `Vector` to try cast functions. Allowing us to be faster and have much better error integrations.

Much of the error-handling code has been rewritten to enable errors to persist until the result chunk is flushed. This approach allows us to accurately log flush casting errors in the reject tables when multiple errors occur on the same line.

Fix: #11832
pr_comments: Is this ready to be merged? :) I would love to test this before the next release hits.

issue_context.title: CSV rejects does not log error for faulty timestamptz and time value
issue_context.body:
### What happens?

When reading [faulty CSV files](https://duckdb.org/docs/data/csv/reading_faulty_csv_files.html), when a column is expected to be a `TIMESTAMPTZ` and you provide a random varchar, there is no result and no error message is logged.

### To Reproduce

Given the following CSV, `datetimes.csv`:

```csv
date,datetime,time,timestamp
not-a-date,not-a-datetime,not-a-time,not-a-timestamp
```

When I run the following command:

```sql
SELECT * FROM read_csv('datetimes.csv', columns={ 'date': 'DATE', 'datetime': 'TIMESTAMPTZ', 'time': 'TIME', 'timestamp': 'TIMESTAMP' }, ignore_errors=true, rejects_table='rejects_table');
```
```text
┌──────┬──────────────────────────┬──────┬───────────┐
│ date │         datetime         │ time │ timestamp │
│ date │ timestamp with time zone │ time │ timestamp │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                       0 rows                       │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
The below faulty lines are returned:

```sql
SELECT * FROM rejects_table;
```
```text
┌─────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────────────────┬───────────────┬───┬─────────────┬──────────────────────┬──────────────────────┬──────────────────────┐
│ scan_id │ file_id │  line  │ line_byte_position │ byte_position │ … │ column_name │      error_type      │       csv_line       │    error_message     │
│ uint64  │ uint64  │ uint64 │       uint64       │    uint64     │   │   varchar   │ enum('cast', 'miss…  │       varchar        │       varchar        │
├─────────┼─────────┼────────┼────────────────────┼───────────────┼───┼─────────────┼──────────────────────┼──────────────────────┼──────────────────────┤
│       8 │       0 │      2 │                 30 │            30 │ … │ date        │ CAST                 │ not-a-date,not-a-d…  │ Error when convert…  │
│       8 │       0 │      2 │                 30 │            67 │ … │ timestamp   │ CAST                 │ not-a-date,not-a-d…  │ Error when convert…  │
├─────────┴─────────┴────────┴────────────────────┴───────────────┴───┴─────────────┴──────────────────────┴──────────────────────┴──────────────────────┤
│ 2 rows                                                                                                                            10 columns (9 shown) │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
```text
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                            error_message                                            │
│                                               varchar                                               │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤

│ Error when converting column "timestamp". Could not convert string "not-a-timestamp" to 'TIMESTAMP' │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

I would expect additional error lines regarding the `datetime`  and `time` column.
